name: Statistical Signal Processing
description:
Properties of autocorrelation and power spectral densities, Wiener-Kintchine theorem, Spectral factorization theorem, Wolds theorem
Properties of autocorrelation matrices of WSS processes, Properties of eigenvalue and eigenvectors of autocorrelation matrices, Cholesky decomposition 
Parametric and non-parametric spectrum estimation, periodogram, and its bias and variance, the modified periodogram, Minimum variance spectral estimation, Maximum entropy spectral estimate,
Parametric spectral estimation, MA, AR and ARMA models, Harmonic process, Subspace techniques, MUSIC, ESPIRIT 
Optimum FIR Linear filtering, Properties of the optimum estimator, optimum forward and backward predictors, Optimum IIR linear filters, MMSE, 
Array Signal processing, optimum array processing, beam forming, angle estimation
Order recursive algorithms, Levinson Durbin algorithm, lattice filters, up-down recursions 
Least-squares estimator, properties, square root techniques, Use of QR and SVD, Pseudo-Inverse
Adaptive filters, Steepest descent algorithm, LMS and its performance, variants, approximate analysis of convergence, excess MSE, 
RLS and its performance, square-root RLS, Kalman Filters
